title: deep-review Q2: state resilience - wire sweepAndRecover, gitignore runtime artifacts, age-gate the tmp sweep, exclusive task create
description: Deep-review confirmed finding (2026-07-02): three silent-corruption classes an unattended loop cannot notice. (a) src/recovery.js sweepAndRecover is written and tested but has ZERO call sites - the state/README.md recovery contract is false; after a mid-write crash orphan tmp files accumulate and a corrupt bundle is not resumable by any new chat. (b) state/.lock and *.tmp.* files are not gitignored while state/ is fully tracked - a broad git add during a run commits the lock, which on machine B blocks acquire(). (c) sweepTasksTmpFiles deletes ANY tasks/*.tmp.* with no age threshold while multiple writer processes exist - it can delete an in-flight tmp between phase 1 and 2 of an atomic write (~250ms window on the Windows retry path) causing partial mutation; and deriveNextKey is TOCTOU - two concurrent createTask calls can silently overwrite each other via unconditional rename.
acceptance_criteria: sweepAndRecover({bundleDir}) is invoked at the bundle-load seams (loadActiveBundle / resumeFromPointer / inspection paths) mirroring the existing task-store sweep pattern; a spec proves an orphan tmp is recovered on load.
Scoped gitignore patterns added (state/.lock, state/**/*.tmp.*, tasks/*.tmp.*) with a git check-ignore spec locking them.
sweepTasksTmpFiles gains an mtime age-gate (~60s) so in-flight tmp files are never deleted; regression spec red-green proven.
createTask cannot silently overwrite an existing task file: exclusive create or verify-after-write on the derived key, throwing a typed error on collision; spec simulates the TOCTOU.
Any dist bundle embedding the touched modules is rebuilt; dist-parity green; tdd - failing tests first for each guard.
